gold: Disseminated Strongyloides stercoralis infection with ocular involvement (choroiditis)

selector.why: The patient's presentation with altered mental status, fever, flaccid paralysis of all extremities, and respiratory failure, along with the finding of larval sections in the eye, is most consistent with Strongyloidiasis, which can cause a hyperinfection syndrome with disseminated disease in immunocompromised hosts.
